Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE individual full-body transparent 2D fighting-game action sprite of ABSTRACTING ZOOBLE. Reference 1 is the approved strict design lock for silhouette, proportions, exact transformation patches, eyes, colours and polished cel shading. Reference 2 supplies official design details only; do not imitate its squat toy proportions, setting or lighting. Mouthless colourful geometric Zooble: pink triangle head half crystalline with one normal white eye and one concentric pastel crystal eye, checkered antenna and crystal lightning crest, yellow spotted oval torso/cyan chest ring, pink rear wing, red curly arm with crystal hand and opposite orange/yellow arm, one normal long blue leg/foot and one crystal lower foot with rear eye-bearing growth. Preserve exact approved asymmetric assembly, no mouth or extra limbs. Create a genuinely distinct natural action pose, not a mirrored/cropped selection image. Every limb, crown/hat/ear tip, attached mask and crystal spike must fit fully inside clear transparent margins on ALL sides. One connected character, crisp detailed 2D art on true transparent RGBA; no scenery, floor, cast shadow, aura, glow, particles, labels, watermark, inset or duplicate. POSE: DEFEAT facing screen RIGHT: safe non-graphic exhausted kneel, one knee down and other foot planted, torso bowed and one hand braced low, head droops. All anatomy, costume and crystal features intact and fully visible.

CORRECTION LOCK: Keep exactly ONE cyan ring at the ORANGE arm's chest joint, matching reference 1. The RED curled arm attaches without any cyan ring. Do not create a second cyan shoulder socket or ring. Preserve all other approved asymmetrical parts and the requested exhausted kneeling pose.
